clean_body: Peter, Time and time again, the vast majority of Americans tell us they believe abortion is health care. But on Friday, six unelected Justices decided to take that right away, in service to the extremist agenda of the GOP. This catastrophic decision will set women and all childbearing people back five decades to a time when they were treated like second-class citizens. Stripping away the right to choose exacerbates cycles of poverty and racism and leaves marginalized people unprotected—especially in states like Missouri.So long as our pregnancies are governable by the state, there can be no freedom for anyone seeking control over their own body and life. While I feel devastated and violated by this decision, there is no time to mourn— only to fight back. If the extremists can take away our bodily autonomy, everything from contraception to LGBTQ+ rights could be on the table. I’m calling upon Congress to urgently codify abortion rights and calling upon every concerned citizen to organize, march, and vote in support of that effort. Any elected leader who lacks the courage to defend our bodies and medical privacy from government overreach has got to go. The right to choose is a fundamental personal freedom. I will do everything I can—both here in Missouri and in Congress—to reinstate and protect that right. I know just how hard these campaigns can be. It is not easy at all.

Friends —
I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, Mark, so he can hold this Arizona Senate seat. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important.
I know just how hard these campaigns can be. It is not easy at all. National Republicans see people like Mark, who is independent and puts his constituents first, as a threat. That’s why we’ve always known that outside groups would come out of the woodwork, spending untold amounts of money to try and take back this Senate seat in November.
In addition to that outside spending, which is already well underway, Donald Trump just endorsed a GOP extremist in this race who is completely wrong for Arizona. What’s more, Donald Trump has also flown to Arizona to hold a rally and said, “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
So, it's clear Trump and National Republicans are already ramping up their efforts to beat Mark.
**Mark needs our help to fight off these attacks, and the best way to do that is by reaching his goals by the time our official FEC fundraising comes to an end and we’re legally required to report our numbers. We can’t afford to fall short. So what do you say?**

name: Giffords
subject: Chris Murphy
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Before he was a Senator, Chris Murphy was the Congressman from Newtown, Connecticut.
#

Friends -
Before he was a Senator, Chris Murphy was the Congressman from Newtown, Connecticut. And like Gabby, he used to say that he didn’t find the issue of gun violence prevention, the issue found him.
Both Gabby and Chris were sworn into Congress at the same time (2006) and started their work on this issue together shortly after the tragedy at Sandy Hook.
There have been few greater allies in Congress than Senator Murphy. Through the years he worked tirelessly to bring together Republicans and Democrats around commonsense solutions to save lives.
Time and time again those efforts came up short, but he never gave up hope, and neither did we.
As a result of his leadership and persistence, along with our national movement for change, we’ve won the first significant gun violence prevention legislation signed into law in almost three decades—legislation that WILL save lives.
So we want to thank Senator Murphy for his leadership and hope you’ll join us:
[**Please use this link to sign our card thanking Senator Chris Murphy for his leadership on the issue of gun violence prevention and we’ll make sure his team gets it this week.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/thank-chris-murphy-em/?source=em220627-1-15&refcode2=2183.3935704.FWMoKQ&t=1&akid=2183%2E3935704%2EFWMoKQ)

The team at Giffords

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp8pjjhkblih3g2aeqi16r18p9d3fhgfa5s8770g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6s3ic9pn5dplm4p6eoj2etgn4dhgedqjddlnc2q66oj4c4o79pb4mpp7eplm6srt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1ddm61p3cphlc2pmadtgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk4vhojdnk86po1ro0u0dkv7n3td24tmoj151o78_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zpep8o013k9ginrije64gd4j10cdqiut37achiso_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlnbufaesqu20en955m1n6d4geqk0s8ocfte18po_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg475cdlf6epn338ekbh18m7fpv9f6mhmb3prqbo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfoe0a5evm031p2ifjm32hbvhcs69pnt0nfj9u10_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zo6glcm8qi7femq9687u5sukp01d3nkvs8n6hseg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zukq6caniikl1caom6upoo4ip7l57nolgjg33u0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoou9r0108eisibatbra3qbjpf8serja0s15h7f8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8s1i9l02mqkq38evei4p7dnctik755tmvkrsj48_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob2cth2bs)

clean_body: But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. body:

I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3uc6hieje16ov0omqflp1a70g6ekjfb3qqn5dtg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob4cjh2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zil10e2fmi30h5qrqieodqr444rrii88hf2fu87o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob4cjh2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpclphjbib64f25p1i040p30hkhtak5pfl1p50a0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cpim6ob4cjh2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

---

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220627&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220627&amount=28]
Team,
Since Elissa first decided to run for office, she’s been concerned that Americans have lost trust in our government and our political process.
It’s why she knew from day one that she would never accept a dime of corporate PAC money. She never wanted her constituents to question why she was voting a certain way, or have any doubt that she was fighting for their interests, and their interests alone.
She’s one of the few members of Congress who have made this pledge from day one, and actually stuck to it. But it goes beyond just sticking to her promise: she’s actually put her money (or in this case, legislation) where her mouth is.
She’s sponsored and co-sponsored a number of bills aimed at fighting corruption and restoring trust in our system. Earlier this year, she signed on to the TRUST in Congress Act and the Ban Conflicted Trading Act, aimed at preventing members of Congress and their spouses from buying and trading stocks while in office – because, you shouldn’t be able to use the privileged information you receive as a representative to make money.
She recently introduced the Cryptocurrency Accountability Act – to require members to disclose any and all cryptocurrency holdings and transactions. And she co-sponsored the Ban Corporate PAC Act – to eliminate the corrupt influence of corporate money.
It shouldn’t surprise anyone that Elissa’s opponent takes the opposite approach. During his time in the state legislature, over 90% (!!) of his funding came from PACs and interest groups. On top of that, he has made it easier for outside, dark money groups to influence elections. He even voted for a bill that enshrined the Citizens United ruling in state law, allowing super PACs to spend unlimited amounts of money on political campaigns.
By contrast, 88% of contributions to Elissa’s campaign are $100 or less. She doesn’t fund her campaign by doing the bidding of corporations, but with generous grassroots supporters chipping in what they can, when they can.
For Elissa, this is a matter of protecting our democracy. It means getting big money out of politics, so elected officials are only beholden to what actually matters: their constituents. Will you chip in to help Elissa continue this fight in Congress? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220627&amount=28]

name: Green Beret Pat Harrigan
subject: I’ve never run from a battle
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Pat Harrigan Committee
body:
When I graduated from West Point, I knew that losing wasn’t an option.| | | Fellow American, I’ve seen too many politicians whose votes don’t line up with their promises to the voters. **When I graduated from West Point, I knew that losing wasn’t an option.

Hello,

We must remember that there is far more that unites us as Americans than divides us.

We have to be able to have debates and discussions about substance and about issues where we can disagree, but where we also remember we are not enemies. We must be able to have those debates and have those discussions based on a foundation of our Constitution.

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znj5srt1ib7e54dsinnn0el0qvv3t7m097pecfk0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ulgm6c30e6pj2d75cepbashm6sq34tjgc5qb4cb66oq68tpnm2rm2sb4m8p31o37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shmcoo71ddgcur68phlc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5cdj66o30c5gm49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaigmu185eortrhci063458nrpfda504li1cu3h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrf21ion986ja0i80pvlssr0c80r86j6dmallac0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdjb5c5vukjrm1hochnkho41pt4pc4muf5vqeghg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaa61jh4d97lsctdd0cj4n00kl8rorhbu4v1k820_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhbshkm2g3tim66gs5snuj33hm4t01gfk3mlh61g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhd69o47nckcqui712s477a66l7sc90qlco7aj78_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdbk4694m1mndbtnismepki406aa5opkkku8r9jg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq741tmb59qc781pv2gl1pbnokc5umed934qd8fo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4qng5249537mgbg1mlqj6f6b6eg8c6fa5ei4qv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0emdordqi92qm95q8c8t70ijlcoqhohcqjou588_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhevan567vuc2a64t0tom8fb1vp36cnsbovarsfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn85uj10bd9oih24i5cbv4hjh36hi8ahn7dkf9tg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd4sam8a4rqio9bjs0q0a9dvjlke4kc3p4u1l3eg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5te1dek5b9eh1qeavjp2jqjpk71sa9jjs8cfolg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs966fj3vt5t32umbiadl2gsk8b0kjhlgu4pr5do_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjvf33nocvs5jqevk1g3pvpf71m2pj9orccn41k8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zimeor9trn9tqmggt6npa6jt8iik2pi5c5fkdfg8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgo9492pcrrgfmo817pso1678b0o6p4l6p1gpoug_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o31c5h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhkrpij6c3cs9n5207p2v4odn3n1n903oe0tce6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o36c9h2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlibg4s9arh2gfpns9qnon3sg54scmvg8cjs4i80_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o36c9h2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2vt43i2s6q8ucv5r31o4ksgi2fch12f262nfdb0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0o36c9h2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

---

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zt3r6ni282eij961scrddb8a7kjr2tu4edl479n8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0p31cph2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That 's why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2cc4v1afuvkak0hvulttqk4o1oails3kb4er6ng_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm0p31cph2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, the people of this district, Texas, and the entire country are still reeling from Friday’s SCOTUS decision that overturned Roe v. Wade. body:
On the same day that he called the Supreme Court’s overturning of Roe v. Wade a “historic victory,” he sided with the corporate gun lobby and voted AGAINST the bipartisan gun safety bill.
#

Losing this race in North Carolina would be a huge setback.
Last week’s SCOTUS decisions made clear how fragile our rights are, and Ted Budd wants to roll back our freedoms even further.
Not only does he want a complete national abortion ban without any exceptions, but he also has no interest in keeping our communities safe with commonsense, bipartisan steps to reduce gun violence.
On the same day that he called the Supreme Court’s overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ a “historic victory,” he sided with the corporate gun lobby and voted AGAINST the bipartisan gun safety bill. BOTH of our state’s current Republican senators helped lead the negotiations for this commonsense legislation.
Ted Budd would be a MASSIVE step backward for our state. He has proven he’s in the pocket of the corporate gun lobby and extreme far-right, and he refuses to defend our rights and freedoms.
Cheri has made clear: She would not have hesitated to vote for commonsense gun safety legislation to keep communities safe and save lives, and she will not hesitate to cast the deciding vote to end the filibuster and codify abortion rights.

name: Patrick Leahy
subject: In the wake of this reckless decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Leahy for U
body:
Friend –

I am horrified that a Republican appointed majority on the Supreme Court has voted to overturn Roe v. Wade, stripping away a person's fundamental right to autonomy over their body.

With this decision now public, our only path forward to protect the right to reproductive choice is through legislation at the federal level.

In the wake of this reckless decision, I'm rushing support to three Democratic challengers who can beat their GOP opponents and help us get this done: John Fetterman in Pennsylvania, Tim Ryan in Ohio, and Cheri Beasley in North Carolina. Will you chip in $10 or more right now to be split between their campaigns?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

This patriarchal, patronizing, and frankly dangerous decision sends us back decades in our shared fight to protect every person's right to reproductive health care.

Furthermore, this decision points to an increasingly politicized judiciary, which seems to only answer to a narrow group of right-wing stakeholders. It is not only a woman's right to choose that is at risk, but our very democracy itself.

Lt. Governor Fetterman, Rep. Ryan, and former Chief Justice Beasley are three leaders I trust to fight fiercely for the right of every woman to make choices about her own body while defending the sanctity of our democracy.

But to get each of them elected this November, expand our Democratic majority, and protect a woman's right to choose, it's going to take all of us. Please, before this week’s end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, will you chip in $10 or more right now?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

Thank you for taking action alongside me to safeguard reproductive health care for all.

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Patrick Leahy
U.S. Senator

body:
And as many of us suspected and feared, it seems that SCOTUS's extremist-packed Court won't stop at Roe.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/nT5FPS7BBAEj9VcmNqneAaAzgZNsH-dGtc1gW4WEkaQ=/8zVPF-TUFI3OMPfCLMFv8TN84FdeKZTpi_HwDhFdrlI=)
**" Justice Thomas: SCOTUS 'should reconsider' contraception, same-sex marriage rulings"**

The Supreme Court's heartbreaking decision to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ and upend decades of settled law will undoubtedly have devastating and lasting repercussions for the most vulnerable and the most marginalized in our community.

**And as many of us suspected and feared, it seems that SCOTUS 's extremist-packed Court won't stop at _Roe._ **

Now, almost immediately after stripping away the fundamental right to reproductive freedom, Justice Clarence Thomas has argued in a concurring opinion that the Supreme Court **" should reconsider" its past rulings codifying rights to contraception access and same-sex marriage. **

**Here 's the bottom line:** In 2022 America,_Griswold, Lawrence, and Obergefell_ - long-standing Court decisions granting the right to essential privacy and freedoms for millions of people across our nation - are at genuine risk of being struck down by the far-right few.

Peter, today, I wish I were coming to you with a more optimistic tone regarding the state of our fundamental freedoms, but the truth is, we are stuck with a Supreme Court that includes Trump-appointed justices who have shown that they are not willing to listen to the majority of the American people who believe in upholding and protecting essential rights and liberties.

**But I 'll leave you with this: **

The midterm election this November is perhaps one of the most critical elections America has ever seen. With decades of settled law on the line, we need to ensure that we protect our Democratic majority in Congress. We must elect Democrats up and down the ballot in order for us to keep moving forward.

**[It's on all of us to stand up for what's right. Add your name to our petition today if you agree with the majority of Americans who believe that love is love - and that everyone deserves access to reproductive healthcare no matter where they live. ](https://act.myngp.com/el/nT5FPS7BBAEj9VcmNqneAaAzgZNsH-dGtc1gW4WEkaQ=/wxDdnJ8VdLbLc3OcYspHBXrxp_n-himOJUL3uSJ62nw=?ms=em22_220627_scotus_engg_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220627_scotus_engg_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220627_scotus_engg_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220627_scotus_engg_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

what I need from you today:
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47058150/352877135/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3638-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDExZDZlOS01N2Y2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qbPmr4dfGdprqcTLXHoKq0hh16dj3VRThjVizamsUeE=)

**I'm reaching out personally to ask for your help today, friend.**
When I first launched this campaign over a year ago, grassroots Democrats like you came out in droves to support me. #
Friend of Life,

This is one of the most surreal moments I've ever experienced.

After decades of marching, advocating, and praying, Roe v. Wade is finally finished, the false "constitutional right" to kill a preborn child has been erased by the United States Supreme Court.

We are experiencing a truly historic victory for life!

I rejoice alongside you for the lives that will be saved due to the reversal of this horrific decision. However, this victory is just the beginning.

Our work to transform our culture and make abortion unthinkable is just getting started.

Abortion advocates are in an uproar, pushing lies that women will die, life-saving medical care will be eliminated, and the reversal of Roe will lead us back to the "Dark Ages."

Remember, abortion is still legal and even subsidized in many states. The killing of preborn babies has not stopped.

We are now fighting an uphill battle against an onslaught of disinformation and deceit -- the same lies that led to the senseless killing of 63 million innocent children.

The pro-life movement is facing its most critical moment in history.

In order to keep up our momentum for life, we need your financial support.

Specifically, I am looking for 50 people who want to protect babies from abortion to step forward and make a $30 gift before midnight tonight. This will enable us to reach 50,000 moms and dads with the truth they need to choose life. Donate here:**[https://give.liveaction.org](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgsvpanoi4r8399d8knhfre9tj6pgrpqju4324s0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphm8o74cth2bs)**

There is no doubt about it: the goal of the abortion lobby is to enshrine the "right" to kill a child through abortion in federal law. Now that they have failed in the Supreme Court, we will see more efforts than ever before to pass a national law forcing abortion on every community.

Pro-abortion activists are hoping we call it victory and walk away from the fight. But we will not make that mistake.

John is known for preaching a progressive message of love and inclusivity to the Christian Community! We connected with John and arranged for him to hold events for Southwest Florida candidates after John pledged to do events in Florida in response to Governor DeSantis' attacks in the LBGTQ+ community. John will be leading a virtual presentation, "Hope and Other Superpowers," on Wednesday, June 29 at 6:30 PM, which will be open to the public with registration required. Proceeds go to a group of local candidates including our campaign. Entrance to the Zoom virtual room requires a donation of $10 dollars, while attending the live presentation via Zoom requires a $25 dollar donation. We'll also be having an in person meet and greet with local candidates, which requires an additional $25 dollar donation. Those coming to the Virtual In-Person Event will have an opportunity to win door prizes and give aways from John and purchase some special items from him. Dear Neighbor,

You are invited to a special fundraising event for Charity Barry for Congress on Thursday, June 30th. For the first time in Wisconsin, the acclaimed one-man show, [The American Soldier](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001c-xvrfgFp67z2SJ9hEisNyRtHRi2hosGeJhlRPXTStQ7Upv1vtr-38XblppPVVSNmSXYNyszrJeD6xpOh1FryYoaeZL6LVBxbe7sYfL1ArqFFYMx5VayeOYA443hXu_t4sTlA71FMcGXW6rKJozfkNrhlxiHT5gAoF-byKrt2ZHgB3PO580siqUsudJZYLlCngwUQIPiuYA=&c=eLnK6q6QzP7xNKsLXtibpW7uheon3sOXtz6XACJb0CKjNBEjIAMtjQ==&ch=rYLJ_epOOapj7OzL22PK7gokL6xCFp-FjW7J0N1etGYNcM_UX5ygbA==), will be performed in Madison. Please see the details below. There is no better way to celebrate the upcoming 4th of July than to honor our veterans. Please RSVP today as seats are limited. Thank you. - Friends of Charity Barry.

"The American Soldier is based and inspired by real stories and letters written by veterans and their families from the American Revolution through the current conflicts in Iraq and Afghanistan. It reveals the struggles American soldiers face at war and their internal struggles to come back home. The show strives to help us understand how and why it is so difficult for men and women in the armed services to re-enter our civilian life when they come back home. Its goal is to honor our veterans and thank their families for their immense sacrifice to our country." body:
| My name is Fred Guttenberg. Since losing my daughter, Jaime, in the Parkland school shooting over four years ago, I’ve dedicated my life to trying to prevent more gun violence tragedies in America.

**That’s why I’m standing with Dr. Annie Andrews in her campaign for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.[Will you join me by contributing to her campaign now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47044413/352833488/1643317256?amount=15&refcode=AA_EM_FR_1MO_20220627_1_2&refcode2=&contactdata=UR8buwvNCiZMyhCzpbSqaYg861MYp2sbwDT9FwUSQlpVX8b6apAz37M8kzNHuljl&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzljODU5Zi0zOWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZFngonRqfAuhOxVDaV7j04mB7OHzXHwseUSm7WK4Pe0=)**

Annie is gearing up to face off against Nancy Mace, an NRA A-lister and MAGA attention seeker who is only in Congress to make TV appearances and increase her own celebrity status.

Mace has failed to take action on the gun violence crisis facing our nation, and premiered a new ad showing her shooting a gun at the camera right after the school shooting in Uvalde.

# Exciting endorsements the day before Election Day.
I have been honored to have some amazing and humbling endorsements in my campaign over the last few months.****_Tomorrow is Primary Election Day. And I’m asking for your vote in the 6th Congressional District GOP Primary._**I am the pro-Law & Order, pro-Second Amendment, pro-Life, pro-Family, America First Candidate in the 6th Congressional District. And I pledge to stand firm on those principles when I go to Congress to represent you.**

Please make certain you go out and vote today or tomorrow to make your voice heard in this primary. You can find voter information you may need [here](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=e9cef2eebb&e=9931950ab1).

If you haven’t yet decided how you’re going to vote, let me share with you some of the endorsements I’ve received.

**Freedom Initiative Now** is the organization founded by [Matrix Home Solutions CEO Nick Richmond and others to restore Freedom in Illinois](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=e024a1578a&e=9931950ab1). They played a significant role helping to lead the successful effort to reverse Governor JB Pritzker’s outrageous COVID mandates, which directly impacted me as an owner of a business that JB deemed “non-essential.” I’m honored to join **Governor candidate Darren Bailey** and **Attorney General candidate Tom DeVore** as the only candidates endorsed by Freedom Initiative Now.
I am also honored by all the wonderful endorsements I’ve received so far. Here’s a short list. And you can find out more information about them on my [website](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=6d1eaade16&e=9931950ab1).

_**Pro-Law & Order:**_
*Mayor Rudy Giuliani
*Bernard Kerik, 40th Police Commissioner of New York City
*Former Chicago FOP President Kevin Graham

_**Pro-Second Amendment:**_
*Former NRA President David Keene, who also was former president of CPAC
*National Association for Gun Rights

_**Pro-Life, Pro-Family:**_
*Illinois Family Action
*Illinois Federation for the Right to Life

_**America First:**_
*Illinois Freedom Caucus Chair, Rep. Chris Miller
*Freedom Initiative PAC
*Illinois Patriots
*Save Illinois

You also should be aware that**I am signed a number of Pledges that represent the principles I will stand for in Congress.** Those pledges include:

*U.S. Term Limits [Pledge](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=87c1f64644&e=9931950ab1)
*Liberty Guard [Pledge](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=54f33a9b28&e=9931950ab1)
*Americans for Tax Reform [Taxpayer Protection Pledge](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=0b14f7f4d1&e=9931950ab1)
*And [I have pledged to only accept a salary of $37,306](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=dddd48c6a5&e=9931950ab1) – the per capita income – and donate the remainder ($136,694) to charity. I will not be controlled by Leadership in the DC swamp!

In Congress, I will fight to make this District safe, to bring more meaningful job opportunities to the District, to reduce our ever-expanding government, restore our liberties, and return us to an America First agenda that will return us from the massive economic failures of the Biden administration.

Now is the time to bring it all together. _We can take the next step toward a renewal of liberty and our America First policies this Tuesday.**I’m asking for your vote in the 6th Congressional District Primary tomorrow.**_ If you have already done so, thank you very much. If not, please don’t forget to go to the polls tomorrow. You can contribute to Kaspar for Congress by clicking [here](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=a2090c61b2&e=9931950ab1).

body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z180gr6j9564m03g0ue6gjp6f4i5n4j565no7k10_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tbjcmq68t31eqpm6t1he5i79clgs1qm2sr0moor2db16him4dr5edom0t1jmgrrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p3cphge2qrcdtiehj3co5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6ktch6shq2lk9pi482co8no2ebp9bsl277jr6l0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm7csct7ngue0d34taim8lamtmvn5i4gqhtimvt8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv49jo4m310jtjtvabjtjfv9ij7jd6tkpplhl4hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrttauidna9siuurap7cqadar1uc8r1ov6mu5n9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlg0ppt6m41iquicrp2k70vrkbtgh0o0g9uogsbo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrgf7nji1723968el9jgut7uh0qmpj1p4dktq1tg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs)** [**DONATE**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zknlmil352vkpfohshtnlmhfgt6nbcdqikn56mig_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs) [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za5ac0b051kmrnt1lurge4fl7ea1oqhjmnaehrog_rp22sh2s8i66pb3cphmcor1c3h2bs) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. subject: Your thoughts on the Second Amendment
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsTwtiAhXN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osTwtiAhXN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous

subject: Here's how we're fighting back
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Wisconsin
body:
Friend -- Democrats held their 2022 State Convention in La Crosse this weekend...and unsurprisingly, **they had NOTHING to say about the issues that are hurting Wisconsin families the most: sky-high inflation, the crippled supply chain, and rising crime.** **** Of course, we knew that Democrats would try to talk about anything but their record, so we decided to hold them accountable: Billboards along I-90 and Highway 53 have been up since Thursday welcoming conventiongoers to La Crosse and reminding them about the issues that matter to Wisconsin families. Inflation has cost the average American family $5,000. To remind the Democrats, our mobile billboard drove around the convention venue all day on Saturday. Our field teams talked to voters at gas stations and distributed these “gas cards” to Wisconsinites frustrated by higher prices. Finally, boaters gathered along the Mississippi River – right behind the convention venue – to show support for Senator Ron Johnson and Republican candidate in the Third Congressional District Derrick Van Orden. **Friend, when it comes to cutting through the noise and holding Democrats accountable through our communications efforts, we don’t mess around.** **[If you’d like to support our future work to make sure voters know the truth about the Democrats’ failed record, you can make a $25 donation that will directly support our communications efforts here.](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVvpUceVrpRCdO5NtXhDcGFYAYkJ9CJAHB8C2z3YLtJ6s&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dem_con_fu_1&n=1)** Thanks, Anna Kelly

_\----- Original Message from Mondaire Jones, June 24, 2022 -----_

Friend,
Today, the radical, far-right majority on the Supreme Court imposed their unpopular, legally unsupported view on the American people – overturning _Roe v. Wade_ and ending the constitutional right to an abortion for millions in this country.
This is the culmination of a decades-long assault waged by the Republican Party against reproductive freedom and our democracy.
**Make no mistake: the Supreme Court’s decision will have lethal consequences for people who need live-saving abortions and, in particular, will compound cycles of poverty and marginalization for Black and brown people who’ve had their constitutional right to choose stripped away. **
This Court is on a rampage. We cannot allow the Court’s 6-3, hyper-partisan majority to continue to chip away at our fundamental rights any longer.

subject: Pres. Biden endorsed our opponent
body:
It’s a sign of desperation when a corporate Democrat needs the President to intervene in a Democratic primary.
#
Peter,
Kina Collins’ primary for IL-7 against the Democratic establishment is TOMORROW. And Kina’s opponent, 25-year incumbent Danny Davis, just got endorsed by President Biden. **It’s a sign of _desperation_ when a corporate Democrat needs the President to intervene in a Democratic primary.**
Nancy Pelosi has been with Davis for months, fundraising and campaigning for him. Democratic Super PACs are dumping in hundreds of thousands of dollars against Kina. Now, Pres. Biden has lined up on the side of corporate donors and the broken status quo in this race. Who else is on Davis’ side?

The events of last week reminded us that once again that we need strong leadership in the United States Congress and on every level of government. Now is the time to prevent gun violence, protect reproductive rights and stop attacks on LQBTQ+, Asian-American, Muslim, Jewish _and every other community._

I've never been one to back down from a fight, and I vow to always stand with you in the toughest fights to ensure that our shared values are represented. But I cannot do it alone. I need your support.

name: Nicole Hammer
subject: Electing Max Miller is dangerous for women
body:
The contrast couldn’t be clearer. Max Miller applauded stripping over 168 million American women of their fundamental rights to body autonomy, while Matthew Diemer vowed to fight for a women’s right to choose. | |
---
