name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Please see – FW: URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships?
body:
I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below.
|
---
| | | [](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkLFugzAQhp8GNiNjEyADQ6QkUxNVKVLVCR32BawasOxDVd--pip7JU_33f3-9elGKw25Sk0juBC8FFVeFWWeZ0XVH4Uo4QCQy7rUScHBoqfMo1t7axTMBOHzuXiFmVqmdGygl72ulZaKC16jxAPqOubkvD8WvarS91t3A2PNPNxhwsbTs_Ohm6GzhgU1LhY8I49AXclExYToRGqbkciFRJ4ScY0voFo96swiaPRhNM7MgQythNnih7jxbcOetuHtTF5XmrqwrLFsIs_OL8GholgkEeWGJtRmnSLCKRb8GyqYHJhhjuNNzv3j5W0ny0w4UwTt43Jqb5d7y15P7NFe2a4xboJzCHYL3c85z2XqG-2-jLUmlFW0Omw__hqkfxn5AeYVjt4) Fellow Conservative, I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training program is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. My staffer Bryan, who oversees the Leadership Institute’s campus programs, sent an urgent email to let me know **the demand by students to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkLFugzAQhp8GNiNjEyADQ6QkUxNVKVLVCR32BawasOxDVd--pip7JU_33f3-9elGKw25Sk0juBC8FFVeFWWeZ0XVH4Uo4QCQy7rUScHBoqfMo1t7axTMBOHzuXiFmVqmdGygl72ulZaKC16jxAPqOubkvD8WvarS91t3A2PNPNxhwsbTs_Ohm6GzhgU1LhY8I49AXclExYToRGqbkciFRJ4ScY0voFo96swiaPRhNM7MgQythNnih7jxbcOetuHtTF5XmrqwrLFsIs_OL8GholgkEeWGJtRmnSLCKRb8GyqYHJhhjuNNzv3j5W0ny0w4UwTt43Jqb5d7y15P7NFe2a4xboJzCHYL3c85z2XqG-2-jLUmlFW0Omw__hqkfxn5AeYVjt4) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkLFugzAQhp8GNiNjEyADQ6QkUxNVKVLVCR32BawasOxDVd--pip7JU_33f3-9elGKw25Sk0juBC8FFVeFWWeZ0XVH4Uo4QCQy7rUScHBoqfMo1t7axTMBOHzuXiFmVqmdGygl72ulZaKC16jxAPqOubkvD8WvarS91t3A2PNPNxhwsbTs_Ohm6GzhgU1LhY8I49AXclExYToRGqbkciFRJ4ScY0voFo96swiaPRhNM7MgQythNnih7jxbcOetuHtTF5XmrqwrLFsIs_OL8GholgkEeWGJtRmnSLCKRb8GyqYHJhhjuNNzv3j5W0ny0w4UwTt43Jqb5d7y15P7NFe2a4xboJzCHYL3c85z2XqG-2-jLUmlFW0Omw__hqkfxn5AeYVjt4) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
* * *
**From:** Bryan Bernys
**To:** Morton Blackwell
**Subject:** URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships? Morton, I just got confirmation that we can move the National Youth Leadership School to the university auditorium. That takes care of the classroom space issues we had. But now there’s a financial issue. With the increase in travel costs, we’ve used up everything in the scholarship fund for students’ travel and hotel rooms. My team still have **50 more applications** to process from students who want to come to the training. Is there any room left in the budget for more student travel scholarships? I don’t want to have to tell my team to turn students away who can’t afford to come, but there’s no other option if we can’t get more scholarship funding. Please let me know how to proceed as soon as possible. Respectfully, Bryan \--
**Bryan Bernys**
Vice President for the Campus Leadership Program
Leadership Institute
---
| | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. Wood Building Arlington VA 22201 United States
---

From: Beto O'Rourke
Date: Saturday, June 25, 2022
Subject: Abbott’s abortion ban

The Supreme Court has ruled that reproductive health care is no longer
federally protected and will now be decided by the individual states.

In Texas, Greg Abbott has already signed a “trigger law” that criminalizes
all abortion — with no exception for rape or incest — and can now go into
effect following yesterday’s decision.

That means that in a matter of weeks, no woman will have control over her
body in Texas, a state that already struggles to ensure proper medical
care for women and girls and which leads much of the developed world in
the rate of maternal mortality. More women face this unprecedented attack
on their freedom and their health in Texas than in any other state in
America.

So it’s on us to respond and to act. That means standing
up to Abbott and fighting for Texas women by winning this election for
governor.

Imagine the impact that will have not only in Texas, but across the
country.

The state that came up with this “trigger law,” the state that has been
leading the attack on a woman’s right to choose for over a decade, and the
state that promised bounty hunters $10,000 to turn in those who helped
women get an abortion can be the state that elects a governor who will
work to ensure that every woman makes her own decisions about her own body
and her own future.

Let’s use these next days — between yesterday’s decision and the
implementation of Abbott’s total abortion ban — to assemble the volunteers
and raise the resources we need to win political power. Do not succumb to
the temptation to despair or give up in the face of this attack. Turn your
anger into action and focus on what will do the greatest good.

The only way to overcome this attack on women and reproductive freedom is
to win this election.

The only way to win this election is with your help.

Peter, this week I was _thrilled_ to attend the St. Louis Pride parade.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47062206/352893337/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk51-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjdhYWUyZi02NWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xFF8vhO3ETc-zJ0y1u_6Hr1ABTa5nQ1GYD9Yrg_RLzc=) _This Valentine knows love is love!_
I was so inspired and moved by the love, joy, and spirit within the LGBTQ community.
I witnessed so much genuine happiness at Pride, but I know this month is not only about celebrating. **It is also about remembering the sacrifices that LGBTQ people and advocates made to create a world where we can all marry who we love and live as our truest selves.**
So during Pride Month, we honor those who worked hard so that we can celebrate today, and we commit ourselves to organizing in the face of challenges still ahead.
I promise that when I serve in the Senate, I will always listen to the concerns of the LGBTQ community, defend our hard-earned rights and freedoms, and serve the interests of ALL Missourians. **Together, we can create a truly inclusive, welcoming country to everyone who calls America home.**
Thank you for standing with me – and happy Pride!

– Trudy

name: Hillary Scholten
subject: Roe struck down
body:
Republicans are already planning to try to pass a federal abortion ban if they take control of Congress.

| On Friday, the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_ , overturning a precedent that protected reproductive freedom for a generation.

While we knew this was coming, it’s still difficult. I am worried, and I am angry. But that doesn’t mean I’m quitting. I am going to continue to fight for our rights, and I hope you will join me.

This decision is not the end. The Court has put this issue squarely back in the hands of the American people, ruling that the right to an abortion is an issue for the people through the democratic process in the states or the U.S. Congress.

Republicans are already planning to try to pass a federal abortion ban if they take control of Congress, and both of my Republican opponents are all in up to make it happen. _**We can’t let that happen.**_

It is so important we win races like this one to stop Republicans from taking back the majority in the House of Representatives.

I am proud to be endorsed by pro-choice organizations like Planned Parenthood and EMILY’s List. I am committed to being an unwavering defender of choice in Congress, but I can’t get to the House without your help. I wish I didn’t have to ask this of you. I wish the stakes weren’t this high, but I know I’m going to need your help.

[_**Will you join me in fighting back against Republican attempts to take our rights? This will be one of the most competitive elections in the country, and it will likely be decided by a razor-thin margin. But Peter, the path to defending the Democratic Majority runs right through Northeast Ohio. That’s why we all need to come together, as a grassroots team, to ensure that Emilia has every resource possible to spread her message of change and combat baseless attacks from the Republican establishment. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = = Thank you for supporting Emilia alongside me. Nancy Pelosi A native of Akron, Ohio, Emilia Sykes has deep roots fighting for Ohioans. She learned from a young age how to use her voice and the power of the people to create change. As the State Representative for Akron and Ohio's State House Minority Leader , Emilia cut through the divisiveness to deliver results. = | = | Emilia Sykes is running to represent Ohio's 13th Congressional District. body:
Peter,

We know the last three months have been dark ones — seeing constitutional rights overturned and the worst mass shooting in a decade have been heartbreaking.

As we wrap up our second quarter since winning the primary, it’s clear the stakes are higher than ever.

That’s why we’ve set an End of Quarter Goal for this campaign that is both ambitious and specific, because we want to make sure we have exactly what we need to gear up for the summer.

We’ve set a high bar for ourselves — we want to raise $16,076 by midnight on Thursday. Can you jump in now and contribute whatever you can towards our goal?

CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220627]

Here’s what we were thinking about when we calculated our End of Quarter Goal:

1. What do we need to do to go into the rest of the summer stronger than ever?
There are a lot of eyes on this race, Peter. This race has quickly become the most competitive district in Texas and our opponents will be watching to see what our numbers look like going into the next quarter. We need to send a message that shows just how serious we are about fighting for Texas.

2. How can we respond to attacks from our opponent?
This part of the race is where things are getting messy. The GOP, the NRA, and dozens of other corporate and special groups have a lot riding on Tony Gonzales. They’re scared of what this campaign means for them — that’s why they are ALREADY attacking us. Our opponents are trying to discredit the strength of our campaign and we need to be prepared to respond to any attacks they try to throw our way.

3. What resources do we need to reach as many voters as possible on the ground?
Moving forward, voter contact is the most important thing we can do — but this part of campaigning isn’t cheap. We need resources to be able to make phone calls, knock doors, pass out literature, and get John around the district to talk to people.

Going into the rest of summer, we need your help to finish out this quarter strong and hit our $16,076 goal. If you have the means, will you donate now to help us gear up for the coming months?

Let’s get to work,
Team Lira

Fair Fight |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47063843/352898801/1793776944?refcode=em_20220627_f_f_roe_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGZhYjQ5Mi02YWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n5GOn-3Egr9EtY_6xCRzqSxpLT_n3ye6mD5N7DIlM58=&emci=5ae36433-64f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=f0fab492-6af6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)

| | The United States Supreme Court has officially overruled _Roe v. Wade_ — relegating decisions about abortion access to each state. **This decision harms everybody, and will have a devastating impact on access to abortion across the country — particularly for people of color, people in rural areas, and those who are struggling to make ends meet. ** We understand that the weight of this decision and this moment in history might feel unbearably heavy. We can and must take time to pause, grieve, and process. Scream into a pillow. Join a protest. **But one thing we can’t do is abandon hope — or each other. ** We still have the power to push for reproductive freedom — by casting our ballots, making our voices heard, and supporting grassroots organizations that are working tirelessly to ensure that people seeking an abortion can access the care they need. [_**Can you split a donation today between three of those organizations — the Feminist Women's Health Center, the SisterSong Women of Color Reproductive Justice Collective, and ARC Southeast?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47063845/352898803/-966041057?refcode=em_20220627_f_f_roe_s1&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGZhYjQ5Mi02YWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n5GOn-3Egr9EtY_6xCRzqSxpLT_n3ye6mD5N7DIlM58=) Here’s a little more background on these groups: The **Feminist Women's Health Center** has been operating in Atlanta and providing care for over 45 years, and is an independent clinic on the front lines of the battle to protect abortion access. The**SisterSong Women of Color Reproductive Justice Collective** is a diverse collective of women of color dedicated to growing and supporting the reproductive justice movement, and to uplifting the voices and building the capacity to win access to abortion and all other reproductive rights. **ARC Southeast** is a fund that helps those in need overcome barriers and ensure they have the resources to access reproductive healthcare, including abortion access, in six states across the Southeast. It’s no coincidence that the same state legislators attacking voting rights are also restricting access to abortion care. They know that our freedom to vote is critical to electing leaders who represent the 8 in 10 Americans who support the legal right to abortion. These legislators attacking rights don’t want to compete in free and fair elections, because they know they can’t win on the merits of their unpopular policies — so they try to create barriers to the ballot box. At Fair Fight, we’ll continue working to ensure free and fair elections for all — so the vast majority of Americans who support _Roe v. clean_body: Split a contribution today between three abortion funds in the Southeast. Fair Fight | | | The United States Supreme Court has officially overruled Roe v. Wade — relegating decisions about abortion access to each state. This decision harms everybody, and will have a devastating impact on access to abortion across the country — particularly for people of color, people in rural areas, and those who are struggling to make ends meet. We understand that the weight of this decision and this moment in history might feel unbearably heavy. We can and must take time to pause, grieve, and process. Scream into a pillow. Join a protest. But one thing we can’t do is abandon hope — or each other. We still have the power to push for reproductive freedom — by casting our ballots, making our voices heard, and supporting grassroots organizations that are working tirelessly to ensure that people seeking an abortion can access the care they need. = Here’s a little more background on these groups: The Feminist Women's Health Center has been operating in Atlanta and providing care for over 45 years, and is an independent clinic on the front lines of the battle to protect abortion access. TheSisterSong Women of Color Reproductive Justice Collective is a diverse collective of women of color dedicated to growing and supporting the reproductive justice movement, and to uplifting the voices and building the capacity to win access to abortion and all other reproductive rights. ARC Southeast is a fund that helps those in need overcome barriers and ensure they have the resources to access reproductive healthcare, including abortion access, in six states across the Southeast. It’s no coincidence that the same state legislators attacking voting rights are also restricting access to abortion care. They know that our freedom to vote is critical to electing leaders who represent the 8 in 10 Americans who support the legal right to abortion. These legislators attacking rights don’t want to compete in free and fair elections, because they know they can’t win on the merits of their unpopular policies — so they try to create barriers to the ballot box. At Fair Fight, we’ll continue working to ensure free and fair elections for all — so the vast majority of Americans who support Roe v. Wade can freely elect leaders who will defend abortion rights and support our freedom to vote. body:
Peter,
I’m sure you’ve been hearing a lot about how the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade will impact our nation. But I wanted to take a second to talk about how this decision will impact women in Florida — because it’s not good.
Florida’s 15-week abortion ban takes effect on July 1st, but with this decision, it won’t be long before the Florida GOP tries to ban all abortions, with no exceptions for rape, incest, human trafficking, or even to save the life of the mother.
It’s horrific that anyone would be so cruel, but DeSantis and his GOP allies have made it clear that they don’t give a damn about women.
And November 8th, 2022, is our last chance to stop them, Peter.
If we elect Nikki as our next Governor this November, she’ll veto any bill that infringes on the rights of Florida women. She’ll fight like hell to protect abortion rights in Florida.
If we don’t, they’ll take away our right to choose.
It’s a simple choice, but it’s also the most important choice our state has had to make in years. And we need to do everything we can to elect a Governor who’s never wavered in the fight for abortion rights.
We can’t give up this fight, Peter. Will you chip in $20 right now to help us reach our goal of raising $73k before the end of the day on July 1st so Florida women don’t lose the rights we’ve had since 1973? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-roe-73k?refcode=627email_2]

clean_body: Democrats know they must re-elect our opponent, the nation’s most vulnerable Democrat, to keep complete control of the federal government. | Fellow American, Our campaign is THE top target of national Democrats. They're nervous because they must re-elect my opponent - who calls himself the most vulnerable incumbent Senate Democrat - in order to keep complete control of the federal government. And they will be watching Team Herschel's fundraising numbers closely. On Thursday, we will close the books for the second quarter of 2022. A few days later, our treasurer will report our fundraising totals to the Federal Election Commission (FEC). The Democrats and their powerful special interests will scour our report page-by-page, looking for any signs of weakness they can find. Fellow American, our goal is to show a massive groundswell of grassroots support from every county in the Peach State and every state in the nation. Our Democrat opponent has shattered early fundraising records and now has more than $23 million in his re-election war chest. Most of that money comes from blue states around the country, from the same folks who think our country is made stronger by pitting us against each other. Georgia's Senate race will almost certainly decide who controls the Senate majority and the direction of our nation. At stake are issues that affect every single one of us: who controls our schools, how much we pay to fill up our gas tank, the rising cost of groceries, and the ability for small businesses to find the workers they need to keep their doors open. Nothing I've accomplished in life has been easy and winning this U.S. Senate seat might be my toughest challenge yet. But we're up to the challenge because we have great friends and supporters like you standing with us every step of the way. Thanks for believing in me and standing by my side. clean_body: Republicans do not have this election in the bag, and if you’re tired of Democrats bad policies that you and your family are paying for everywhere, then we need to step it up immediately. | Fellow American, it’s Tyler (the Marine Raider who did four overseas tours and is now on a mission to secure a seat in Congress and flip the majority for Republicans). I’ve emailed you, texted you, called you, maybe even knocked on your door, but now I really need you to pay attention. Republicans do not have this election in the bag, and if you’re tired of Democrats bad policies that you and your family are paying for everywhere , then we need to step it up immediately. The short version: Democrats are outraising Republicans 2:1 and are amped up to keep their majority. If people don’t start paying attention, we will lose the House AGAIN and give Pelosi, AOC, and Craig two more years of FULL government control. I’m running in a toss-up district and falling behind in fundraising - The long version: I’m sure you know how bad things are... and it’s only going to get worse if we hand Democrats back the House in November. Everything is more expensive--that is if you can even get anything, due to scarcity. Kids are being used as political pawns. Our God-given rights are being threatened. And the Liberal media has NOTHING to say about Democrat’s failures. What you may not know is just how important my race is. Democrats and Republicans alike have marked this as a top-five targeted seat, because my ultra-radical incumbent opponent is vulnerable - which is why Democrats are investing millions of dollars in her. In 2020 when I ran for this same seat, I lost by just 2% - sending my opponent to Washington (where she voted with Pelosi 98% of the time). We cannot afford to fall short again when there is so much on the line. So, now you see why I had to email you and ask for your immediate support. We are entering into the most important midterm election of our lives. What happens now, will determine what our kids’ futures look like. It will determine the future of America. If that is not worth fighting for, I don’t know what is. I often ask myself, what would have happened if I would have emailed one more person or made one more phone call - I may never know. Maybe it’s the Marine in me or just my go-getter spirit, but I’m not leaving anything on the table this time around. The stakes are just too high. Winning this race, means winning back the House. It’s time to fire the Congressmen and Congresswomen who hate America - starting with my opponent. Please, Fellow American - pay attention before it’s too late. I’m begging you. In service, Tyler Kistner Father. Husband. Marine. | | | ---|---|--- | PAID FOR BY KISTNER FOR CONGRESS Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but .

| | Despite the decision overturning _Roe_ , the Supreme Court is not the final word on abortion access. Congress has the power to protect abortion rights by passing the Women’s Health Protection Act. Senator Warner is fighting as hard as he can to rally his colleagues to pass this essential bill, but he also needs you to add your voice. [_**Sign on right now to urge Congress to act to protect reproductive rights.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065547/352904523/820077879?ms=mw_em_220627_1&refcode=mw_em_220627_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2ExMzg2NS02ZGY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qPLMxxoKIT_2G6bTyjeIN9GipJP6o48XEnR0G3B6-6c=&emci=094fe042-65f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=53a13865-6df6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237) Thank you, Team Warner ——Original message from Senator Mark Warner—— Derek, The Supreme Court just overturned the constitutional right to abortion. We saw this decision coming after the draft majority opinion leaked last month, but that doesn’t make it any easier to stomach. Because of the ruling, states will now be able to make abortion illegal. I know a lot of people are wondering what we can do. One important task is to continue our work to put more pro-choice leaders into office. Here in Virginia, I am working hard to support the campaigns of candidates who will protect abortion access in the Commonwealth. My campaign is also supporting candidates nationwide who support the Women’s Health Protection Act. This federal bill would codify into federal law the right to an abortion, and would nullify the Supreme Court’s attack on women’s reproductive rights. But the only way it will pass is if we expand our majorities in both the House and the Senate. [_**We do not have time for despair. We must stand stronger than ever before in defense of reproductive rights. Will you add your name now if you are still with us in this fight?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065548/352904524/820077879?ms=mw_em_220627_1&refcode=mw_em_220627_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2ExMzg2NS02ZGY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qPLMxxoKIT_2G6bTyjeIN9GipJP6o48XEnR0G3B6-6c=&emci=094fe042-65f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=53a13865-6df6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237) I promised when the draft opinion leaked that I would do everything in my power to protect access to abortion. And that is what I plan to do. Today’s decision does not change my fundamental belief that everyone deserves the right to make their own reproductive health decisions, and that those decisions should be made without interference from politicians. Thank you, and I will be sure to keep you updated on this fight, Mark **[Add your Name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065549/352904525/820077879?ms=mw_em_220627_1&refcode=mw_em_220627_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1M2ExMzg2NS02ZGY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qPLMxxoKIT_2G6bTyjeIN9GipJP6o48XEnR0G3B6-6c=&emci=094fe042-65f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=53a13865-6df6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237)**

clean_body: We must oust Sinema and elect Senators who will protect the rights, health, and lives of Americans. | | | Peter, Kyrsten Sinema once famously swore her oath of office on the Constitution instead of a Bible. Now she stands idly by while an illegitimate, stolen, extremist Supreme Court tears down the separation of church and state, and imposes its far-right ideology on the country. We’re not just talking about the overturning of Roe v. Wade. Last week, the Court ruled against common-sense gun safety legislation and forced a state to direct public school funding to religious private schools. Soon, the Court is expected to severely weaken the EPA’s ability to combat climate change and uphold Trump’s xenophobic “Remain in Mexico” asylum policy. And of course, we can’t ignore Justice Clarence Thomas’ ominous declaration that the Court should revisit landmark cases Griswold(contraception), Lawrence(same-sex intimacy), and Obergefell (same-sex marriage). ** Still, Krysten Sinema continues to do** nothing. She’d rather burnish her “bipartisan” image than actually protect her constituents by abolishing the filibuster and codifying Roe into law — let alone do anything to reform a rogue Supreme Court that is radically at odds with the will of the American people. ** The fallout of the Supreme Court’s crusading has been immediate and devastating. In Sinema’s state of Arizona, nearly all abortion providers have put their services on hold until there’s a clearer understanding of just how restricted abortion will legally become. Sharing some of the most important moments in my life.
| [**_Friend, I’d like to tell you about a few of the most important moments in my life, but first, I need to ask for your help. We’re about to hit our major June 30th filing deadline, and my team and I are working hard to bring in every last possible cent. We set a goal to raise an additional $15,000 before the end of June. Can you chip in right now?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065897/352906017/-314146311?refcode=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc1OWJmOC02ZWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ff_3jnI9nFJ4_JRBs46lQfCyLRzuq3lYnRxQHWzI5c8=)
* * *
My story isn’t like those of most politicians, friend. I’m a fifth-generation Texan from Brownsville. My parents were public school teachers, and eventually my father was elected to serve as a state district judge. My parents both taught me that serving your community is a privilege. My childhood was filled with advocacy for women, border communities like ours, and people with disabilities — like my brother, Robby. **I was always politically involved. Here I am at age 4 with my hero, Governor Ann Richards.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065898/352906018/-314146311?refcode=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc1OWJmOC02ZWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ff_3jnI9nFJ4_JRBs46lQfCyLRzuq3lYnRxQHWzI5c8=) When I grew up, I went to law school to become a civil rights lawyer and an ACLU staff attorney. I’ve advocated for women, children, and families — including those ripped apart by Donald Trump’s cruel border policies. One of my most important cases involved Jane Doe, an immigrant teen who was denied her right to an abortion. I took on the Trump administration and Brett Kavanaugh in that case, the only abortion case Kavanaugh heard as a federal judge. **We won.** Now, the “Garza Notice” informs immigrants of their right to receive an abortion free from interference. **And when Trump nominated Kavanaugh to sit on the Supreme Court, I testified against him during his Senate hearings, telling the world exactly why he should NEVER have been confirmed.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065899/352906019/-314146311?refcode=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc1OWJmOC02ZWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ff_3jnI9nFJ4_JRBs46lQfCyLRzuq3lYnRxQHWzI5c8=) Radical right-wingers like those in the Trump administration — and like my opponent, Ken Paxton — are the reason I got in this race in the first place. **Last year, Texas Republicans enacted the _most_ extreme abortion ban in the country since _Roe v. Wade_ , stripping pregnant Texans of the fundamental human right to make decisions about their own bodies.** I was also pregnant with my first child, a baby girl. I couldn’t imagine her growing up in a state where she can’t make her own decisions regarding her reproductive future. As a lifelong advocate for reproductive rights, I knew I couldn’t sit by. I launched my campaign to END the GOP’s one-party rule over our state and fight for the restoration of our fundamental rights. **Then, one month ago, I became the Democratic nominee for Attorney General, and my daughter was with me.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47065900/352906020/-314146311?refcode=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.a4759bf8-6ef6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDc1OWJmOC02ZWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ff_3jnI9nFJ4_JRBs46lQfCyLRzuq3lYnRxQHWzI5c8=) **Friend, I’m Rochelle Garza. I can DEFEAT Ken Paxton and return the Attorney General’s office _to the people_ — but I need you with me.** **_[Donate $5, $25, $50 or any amount that’s right for you before 11:59 CT on Thursday to name: Ryan D. Kelley
subject: Is your chosen candidate lying to you?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MICHIGAN FOR RYAN D
body:
Will he really keep his promises?
| | | |
---
|
---
|

Peter,
How do you know if your chosen candidate will do what he promises, once he is elected to office?
It's simple. See if his words align with his actions.
Back in May, I was one of the top 5 candidates for Michigan governor invited to the June 2nd Detroit Regional Chamber of Commerce's Gubernatorial Debate, at the Mackinac Policy Conference.
I was thrilled and couldn't wait to debate the other candidates, until I realized that the conference had a vaccine passport/negative PCR test requirement.
Therefore, I chose to boycott the debate.
I didn't expect all the candidates to stand with me, but I expected at least one or two candidates to do so.
After all, at a previous debate, each of them promised to fight mask and vaccine mandates, if elected.
To my surprise, no one stood with me.
---
---
John Adams once said:
"Always stand on principle.... even if you stand alone." I stood alone because I could not stomach breaking my promise to fight these mask and vaccine mandates.
I will not betray my supporters and future constituents. Many tried to convince me to attend. Some told me that I could not afford to miss the MASSIVE exposure it would give me. It would be foolish for me to miss the chance to be in front of all those cameras. Others said that vaccine passports or Covid-19 tests were not required for the outdoor event, so what was the big deal?
Although the requirement was waived for the outdoor debate, those who attended the conference absolutely had to show a vaccine passport or provide a negative PCR test. I refused to support "vaccines for thee, but not for me."
---
---
So, yes, I sacrificed the exposure to take a stand for the people of Michigan.
What a missed opportunity for the Republican party!
Peter, When you vote in the primary for the candidate you believe will stand strong - the candidate that is likely to be immune to corruption, remember Mackinac. When you choose the candidate that will act for the people, and not for his own self-interest, remember Mackinac. If you desire someone who shuns elitism and special rules for the elites, remember Mackinac. Thomas Jefferson said,
"If you want something you've never had, you must be willing to do something you've never done." We do not have to keep electing candidates who say they will do one thing and do another, as soon as they're in office. This is how we end up with RINOs.
Why not do something different so we can have a different result? If you elect me for governor, rest assured, I will keep the promises I make to you.
---

clean_body: Will he really keep his promises? | | | | | | Peter, How do you know if your chosen candidate will do what he promises, once he is elected to office? It's simple. See if his words align with his actions. Back in May, I was one of the top 5 candidates for Michigan governor invited to the June 2nd Detroit Regional Chamber of Commerce's Gubernatorial Debate, at the Mackinac Policy Conference. I was thrilled and couldn't wait to debate the other candidates, until I realized that the conference had a vaccine passport/negative PCR test requirement. Therefore, I chose to boycott the debate. I didn't expect all the candidates to stand with me, but I expected at least one or two candidates to do so. After all, at a previous debate, each of them promised to fight mask and vaccine mandates, if elected. To my surprise, no one stood with me. John Adams once said: "Always stand on principle.... even if you stand alone." I stood alone because I could not stomach breaking my promise to fight these mask and vaccine mandates. I will not betray my supporters and future constituents. Many tried to convince me to attend. Some told me that I could not afford to miss the MASSIVE exposure it would give me. It would be foolish for me to miss the chance to be in front of all those cameras. Others said that vaccine passports or Covid-19 tests were not required for the outdoor event, so what was the big deal? Although the requirement was waived for the outdoor debate, those who attended the conference absolutely had to show a vaccine passport or provide a negative PCR test. I refused to support "vaccines for thee, but not for me." So, yes, I sacrificed the exposure to take a stand for the people of Michigan. What a missed opportunity for the Republican party! Peter, When you vote in the primary for the candidate you believe will stand strong - the candidate that is likely to be immune to corruption, remember Mackinac. When you choose the candidate that will act for the people, and not for his own self-interest, remember Mackinac. If you desire someone who shuns elitism and special rules for the elites, remember Mackinac. Thomas Jefferson said, "If you want something you've never had, you must be willing to do something you've never done." We do not have to keep electing candidates who say they will do one thing and do another, as soon as they're in office. This is how we end up with RINOs. Why not do something different so we can have a different result? If you elect me for governor, rest assured, I will keep the promises I make to you. | The Primary Election is 5 weeks away! == As always, I am humbled and grateful for your support | == To liberty! Fellow American,

#

In just a minute, we’re going to ask you to make a contribution to Alex Padilla’s campaign ahead of the FEC deadline on June 30th. But first, we wanted to take this chance to explain exactly why this deadline is so important to our campaign.
After every quarter, the Federal Election Commission requires candidates for federal office to publicly report how much money they’ve raised.
Every single candidate, from the House of Representatives all the way to President Biden, is required to file reports detailing how much money they’ve raised and from which sources.
The Q2 deadline is in just **3 days** , and it’s one of the most important deadlines of this whole race, because this report will be the first time our numbers are public since the start of the general election.
That means everyone, from our opponent to the press to the California GOP, is going to be looking extremely closely. With so many eyes on us, we can’t afford to come up short.
So please:
[**Make a contribution to Alex’s campaign for U.S. Senate in California. Our FEC deadline is in just 3 days, and we’re counting on you to help us hit our goals and make sure we have the resources to hold this seat.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22.3xful1&refcode=em220627-1-90&t=1&akid=875%2E159979%2EI8aiYM)

# Dear Peter,

Tomorrow is Election Day, and I am confident that Team Dahm has done everything in our power to mobilize our message of individual liberty and limited government across the state of Oklahoma. Christina and I have been campaigning nonstop and speaking with voters about a variety of issues that matter most to the people of Oklahoma and we are determined to bring home a victory tomorrow night. Polls are open from 7 am to 7 pm tomorrow. Make sure you have your plan to vote and are ready to execute. If you have any questions about where to vote or if you are in need of a ride, please call or text me at (918) 615-2335 or email me at Nathan@DahmForSenate.com. I am running for the United States Senate because it is your voice that lacks representation in Washington. I know these past two years of government tyranny, mainstream media propaganda, and the questions and concerns lingering around the 2020 Presidential election have forced many true conservatives away from voting, but I am urging you to make an exception tomorrow. We have an opportunity to take our country back from the corrupt radical left and make America first again. Without your support tomorrow, we run the risk of RINO representation in Washington for the next six years. My record as a state senator is evidence of what I will do in Washington. I'm running because the career Republicans in Washington have sold us out to advance their own political careers, and we need to take back our country before it's too late. I am counting on your support tomorrow, Peter, and, together, we will change the course of American history. For Liberty, Nathan Dahm

Friend,

That's me you're looking at.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47067154/352911539/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3616-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNDZkMTM0Ni03NWY2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qwIGf-HnZTWHux5n1_yqZf5lmCdDit659_-V6BIsKbs=)I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would become the first in my family to graduate college, the first woman to lead the Orlando Police Department, a congresswoman and a candidate for the U.S. Senate, well – I just don't know if I would have believed you. What I _did_ believe then – and what I carry deep in my soul to this day – is the lesson from my hardworking parents to "never tire of doing good."
It was my parents' words that inspired me to get into public service. It was their words that have driven me to do good every chance I get. From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to my work representing my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear.
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible and what should be possible for every American. **As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will _never tire_ in the work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. **I will _never tire_ in continuing to do more good for you and your family.
But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either: The Republican National Committee chair is already attacking me personally, while Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are ready to dump tens of MILLIONS into Florida to defeat me.

This is already shaping up to be the most expensive Senate election _ever –_ and with Florida's last Senate race being decided by a narrow 0.12% margin, every dollar we raise will count tremendously. **I know a thing or two about winning tough races, but I need your help because I can't do this alone.**
**[I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks – and right now, I'm falling short of my midnight goal. # Come to our Election Night Watch Party
## June 27, 2022
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Tomorrow night, the honor of your company at the Erik Aadland for Congress Election Night Watch Party in Lakewood is requested.

Accommodation is by Hangar 101 in Lakewood, this will be an evening of camaraderie, conversation, billiards, food and drink.

Join Erik, his family, staff, and supporters to watch the results as they come in for this significant primary election.
|
---
|
---
|
---
| "I am excited to spend election night with the amazing people who have supported this campaign. I'm confident the work my team and I have put into nearly a year on the campaign trail will culminate in a victory. I'm so grateful to everyone who has supported me, tomorrow's win will truly be a team effort. CD7 needs a candidate who will go to Washington and fight for the conservative values that have been slowly taken from us. I am that candidate and look forward to tomorrow's results."
---
---
| |
---
|
---
|

---
| |
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

I’d like to talk about concrete next steps for defending abortion rights, now that Roe is gone. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47067550/352917830/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ6J_NYT_E_20220627_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTJmZmZkZS03N2Y2LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fIugPwMDi3Bqe-sNQfnpgqMUBSkJXrUDSI1IRhI1ogo=&emci=202fffde-77f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=252fffde-77f6-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)

Now is the moment to channel our anger into action. I’d like to talk about concrete next steps for defending abortion rights, now that Roe is gone. I wrote a New York Times op-ed with my friend and colleague Senator Tina Smith — the only member of the U.S. Senate to have worked at Planned Parenthood — about what we saw before Roe, and how we plan to keep up the fight from here on out. **Give it a read below, reply back to this email with any thoughts or questions you have, and stay in this fight.** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth
* * *
**OPINION**
**GUEST ESSAY** **Elizabeth Warren and Tina Smith: We’ve Seen What Will Happen Next to America’s Women** The Supreme Court has spoken: Roe is gone. But the Supreme Court doesn’t get the final say on abortion. The American people will have the last word through their representatives in Congress and the White House. With its decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization, an extremist Supreme Court has overturned nearly 50 years of precedent, stripping away the constitutional right to an abortion and ruling that the government — not the person who is pregnant — will make the critical decision about whether to continue a pregnancy. At least nine states have already banned abortion; over a dozen more could soon follow suit by severely restricting or outright outlawing abortion, putting the lives, health and futures of girls and women at risk. If we sound angry and alarmed, that’s because we are. This decision is devastating — and we have seen what happens next. We both lived in an America where abortion was illegal. A nation in which infections and other complications destroyed lives. A nation in which unplanned pregnancies derailed careers and livelihoods. A nation in which some women took their own lives rather than continue pregnancies they could not bear. But we must hold on to hope. Each of us can and should act — both elected officials and everyday Americans. We can start by helping those who need access to an abortion. Support Planned Parenthood and other organizations that are expanding their services in states where abortion is available. Contribute to abortion funds. Encourage state legislators to protect reproductive rights in states like New Mexico and Minnesota that border places where abortion services will most likely be severely restricted and even criminalized. Encourage employers in states with abortion bans to give their employees adequate time off and money for travel to find the abortion care they need. Do all you can — and demand the same all-you-can approach from all of our elected leaders. Earlier this month, along with Senator Patty Murray and half the Senate Democratic Caucus, we sent a letter to President Biden outlining executive actions he could take to defend reproductive freedom. These actions include increasing access to abortion medication, providing federal resources for individuals seeking abortion care in other states and using federal property and resources to protect people seeking abortion services locally. We need action, and we need it now. On Friday, with the release of the Dobbs decision, we entered a perilous time that threatens millions of women across this nation. We urge the president to declare a public health emergency to protect abortion access for all Americans, unlocking critical resources and authority that states and the federal government can use to meet the surge in demand for reproductive health services. The danger is real, and Democrats must meet it with the urgency it deserves. We’re in this dark moment because right-wing politicians and their allies have spent decades scheming to overrule a right many Americans considered sacrosanct. Passing state laws to restrict access to abortion care. Giving personhood rights to fertilized eggs. Threatening to criminalize in vitro fertilization. Offering bounties for reporting doctors who provide abortion services. Abusing the filibuster and turning Congress into a broken institution. Advancing judicial nominees who claimed to be committed to protecting “settled law” while they winked at their Republican sponsors in the Senate. Stealing two seats on the Supreme Court. For nearly 50 years, right-wing extremists rejected the beliefs held by an overwhelming majority of Americans. They doubled and redoubled their efforts to create a future in which women and their doctors could face a prison sentence for seeking or providing basic health care. When these extremists couldn’t impose their radical views through the legislative process, they stacked the courts. And now that the Supreme Court has opened the door by overturning Roe, Republicans will continue their assault on our civil rights and liberties. Former Vice President Mike Pence called for a national ban on abortion in all 50 states; Mitch McConnell, the Senate minority leader, flat out stated that it’s a possibility. And the logic laid out by the majority in Dobbs seems to undercut other precedents, raising the alarming possibility that we could soon see an assault on privacy and marriage equality. In order to fix the damage Republicans have done to our system in their efforts to control women’s lives, we need broad democracy reform: changing the composition of the courts, reforming Senate rules like the filibuster, and even fixing the outdated Electoral College that allowed presidential candidates who lost the popular vote to take office and nominate five of the justices who agreed to end the right to an abortion. We can’t undo in five months the damage it took Republicans five decades to accomplish, but we can immediately start repairing our democracy. The public is overwhelmingly on our side. A vast majority of Americans oppose the decision the Supreme Court just made. Nearly two-thirds of Americans believe that abortion should be legal in all or most cases. And more Americans describe themselves as pro-choice today than at any other point in the last 25 years. Let’s be clear: Roe may be gone, but the protections it once guaranteed are on the ballot. States like Kansas and Kentucky have initiatives to strip away state constitutional protections for abortion, while Michigan and Vermont are working toward statewide votes to create constitutional protections for reproductive freedom. But make no mistake, this radical decision affects all Americans, not just those in states where the right to a safe, legal abortion will soon fall. Now is the time to demand that every single candidate for every single office voice a firm position on reproductive rights. Ask every Senate candidate to commit to reforming the filibuster rules, so that the chamber can pass federal legislation protecting the right to reproductive freedom. If voters help us maintain our control of the House and expand our majority in the Senate by at least two votes this November, we can make Roe the law all across the country as soon as January. Simply put: We must restore our democracy so that a radical minority can no longer drown out the will of the people. This will be a long, hard fight, and the path to victory is not yet certain. But it’s a righteous fight that we must win — no matter how long it takes. The two of us lived in an America without Roe, and we are not going back. Not now. Not ever.

I wrote a New York Times op-ed with my friend and colleague Senator Tina Smith — the only member of the U.S. Senate to have worked at Planned Parenthood — about what we saw before Roe, and how we plan to keep up the fight from here on out. Give it a read below, reply back to this email with any thoughts or questions you have, and stay in this fight. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth OPINION GUEST ESSAY Elizabeth Warren and Tina Smith: We’ve Seen What Will Happen Next to America’s Women** The Supreme Court has spoken: Roe is gone. But the Supreme Court doesn’t get the final say on abortion. The American people will have the last word through their representatives in Congress and the White House. With its decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization, an extremist Supreme Court has overturned nearly 50 years of precedent, stripping away the constitutional right to an abortion and ruling that the government — not the person who is pregnant — will make the critical decision about whether to continue a pregnancy. At least nine states have already banned abortion; over a dozen more could soon follow suit by severely restricting or outright outlawing abortion, putting the lives, health and futures of girls and women at risk. If we sound angry and alarmed, that’s because we are. This decision is devastating — and we have seen what happens next. We both lived in an America where abortion was illegal. A nation in which infections and other complications destroyed lives. A nation in which unplanned pregnancies derailed careers and livelihoods. A nation in which some women took their own lives rather than continue pregnancies they could not bear. But we must hold on to hope. Each of us can and should act — both elected officials and everyday Americans. We can start by helping those who need access to an abortion. Support Planned Parenthood and other organizations that are expanding their services in states where abortion is available. Contribute to abortion funds. Encourage state legislators to protect reproductive rights in states like New Mexico and Minnesota that border places where abortion services will most likely be severely restricted and even criminalized. Encourage employers in states with abortion bans to give their employees adequate time off and money for travel to find the abortion care they need. Do all you can — and demand the same all-you-can approach from all of our elected leaders. Earlier this month, along with Senator Patty Murray and half the Senate Democratic Caucus, we sent a letter to President Biden outlining executive actions he could take to defend reproductive freedom. These actions include increasing access to abortion medication, providing federal resources for individuals seeking abortion care in other states and using federal property and resources to protect people seeking abortion services locally. We need action, and we need it now. On Friday, with the release of the Dobbs decision, we entered a perilous time that threatens millions of women across this nation. We urge the president to declare a public health emergency to protect abortion access for all Americans, unlocking critical resources and authority that states and the federal government can use to meet the surge in demand for reproductive health services. The danger is real, and Democrats must meet it with the urgency it deserves. We’re in this dark moment because right-wing politicians and their allies have spent decades scheming to overrule a right many Americans considered sacrosanct. Passing state laws to restrict access to abortion care. Giving personhood rights to fertilized eggs. Threatening to criminalize in vitro fertilization. Offering bounties for reporting doctors who provide abortion services. Abusing the filibuster and turning Congress into a broken institution. Advancing judicial nominees who claimed to be committed to protecting “settled law” while they winked at their Republican sponsors in the Senate. Stealing two seats on the Supreme Court. For nearly 50 years, right-wing extremists rejected the beliefs held by an overwhelming majority of Americans. They doubled and redoubled their efforts to create a future in which women and their doctors could face a prison sentence for seeking or providing basic health care. When these extremists couldn’t impose their radical views through the legislative process, they stacked the courts. And now that the Supreme Court has opened the door by overturning Roe, Republicans will continue their assault on our civil rights and liberties. Former Vice President Mike Pence called for a national ban on abortion in all 50 states; Mitch McConnell, the Senate minority leader, flat out stated that it’s a possibility. And the logic laid out by the majority in Dobbs seems to undercut other precedents, raising the alarming possibility that we could soon see an assault on privacy and marriage equality. In order to fix the damage Republicans have done to our system in their efforts to control women’s lives, we need broad democracy reform: changing the composition of the courts, reforming Senate rules like the filibuster, and even fixing the outdated Electoral College that allowed presidential candidates who lost the popular vote to take office and nominate five of the justices who agreed to end the right to an abortion. We can’t undo in five months the damage it took Republicans five decades to accomplish, but we can immediately start repairing our democracy. The public is overwhelmingly on our side. A vast majority of Americans oppose the decision the Supreme Court just made. Nearly two-thirds of Americans believe that abortion should be legal in all or most cases. And more Americans describe themselves as pro-choice today than at any other point in the last 25 years. Let’s be clear: Roe may be gone, but the protections it once guaranteed are on the ballot. States like Kansas and Kentucky have initiatives to strip away state constitutional protections for abortion, while Michigan and Vermont are working toward statewide votes to create constitutional protections for reproductive freedom. But make no mistake, this radical decision affects all Americans, not just those in states where the right to a safe, legal abortion will soon fall. Now is the time to demand that every single candidate for every single office voice a firm position on reproductive rights. Ask every Senate candidate to commit to reforming the filibuster rules, so that the chamber can pass federal legislation protecting the right to reproductive freedom. If voters help us maintain our control of the House and expand our majority in the Senate by at least two votes this November, we can make Roe the law all across the country as soon as January. Simply put: We must restore our democracy so that a radical minority can no longer drown out the will of the people. This will be a long, hard fight, and the path to victory is not yet certain. But it’s a righteous fight that we must win — no matter how long it takes. The two of us lived in an America without Roe, and we are not going back. Not now. Not ever. | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

subject: What matters most to you?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
The State of Arizona deserves better — we need secure elections that we can trust | | |
---
| | Good afternoon Freedom Fighters,

What matters most to you in the 2022 election? For many, it’s securing the border, making ends meet under Biden’s oppressive economy, or seeing our children receive an education free of indoctrination. As Republicans, we take these issues seriously. As a conservative legislator, I fought for Life; I voted to secure the border, cut taxes, and promote healthy families; and I protected our First and Second Amendment rights without wavering.
---
| [Arizona Needs Unwavering Conservative Leaders](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=679fa7f0ce&e=a7ab36849c "Arizona Needs Unwavering Conservative Leaders")
---
| **Life**
_Roe_ and _Casey_ have been overturned and the issue of limiting abortion is returning to the state’s and Arizona’s [pre-Roe](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=084d14d069&e=a7ab36849c) law stands. It’s illegal for anyone, including physicians, to assist someone wishing to obtain an abortion. In Arizona, we passed [a common-sense limit on abortions](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=06b9df2f92&e=a7ab36849c) this past session. The life movement in Arizona truly begins now. **We have a[responsibility](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=268cf0307f&e=a7ab36849c) in 2022 to elect leaders that stand up for life and support women facing unplanned pregnancies. **

**Immigration**
The last month under Biden was our worst month at the border yet. [Ten times more illegal migrants](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c061a66fe2&e=a7ab36849c) tried to cross this May under Biden than under Trump’s last May. The fentanyl, methamphetamine, and Cartel members that are following them are destroying our neighborhoods. Though we just passed a budget with [half a billion dollars dedicated to border defense](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4bba628076&e=a7ab36849c), as long as Biden is in the White House, the battle for border security isn’t over. In last week’s budget, I voted for more than $560 million for the Border Security Fund and new Border Strike Force funding. Some of these dollars were allocated for a physical and virtual border fence. **We need to elect conservative champions that will keep our state secure in 2022.**

**Economy**
Biden has demolished our economy—U.S. [inflation hit 8.6%](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=fa81fc27be&e=a7ab36849c) in May, Phoenix’s most recent [inflation rate is about 30% higher at 11%](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b54d064377&e=a7ab36849c), and Arizona gas prices have been [hitting daily all-time highs for weeks](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a02c44cc32&e=a7ab36849c). Fixed-income seniors, small business owners, fresh graduates, and new families are struggling the most to make ends meet. **We need to elect representatives that cut taxes, promote growth, and put Arizona’s —not the radical Left’s — energy agenda first.**

**Parents’ Rights**
In Arizona the Left is confused about what a woman is and what we should be teaching our children. We passed [commonsense bills](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d7289eff95&e=a7ab36849c) protecting women’s sports and our youth from ideologues peddling gender ideology. **But we are only one bad election from the Left injecting poisonous ideologies into our classrooms. **
---
| [Help Build the #RedWave in 2022!](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=22424fbbb3&e=a7ab36849c "Help Build the #RedWave in 2022!")
---
| Why talk about life or the economy as a Secretary of State (SOS) candidate? And what do parental rights or immigration have to do with the office?

**If we don’t have free, fair elections, none of this is possible.**

We won’t be able to elect the best candidates to fix these issues in the legislature if we don’t find a new SOS that keeps our elections secure. Everything is at stake in this election. Arizona needs a conservative champion for election integrity with a plan. Someone better than Katie Hobbs. I’ll leave my politics at the door and get to work as Arizona’s next chief election officer. I have [a plan that none of my opponents can touch](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3e50f8e8c8&e=a7ab36849c), and when I am sworn into office as our next Secretary of State, I’ll hit the ground running and work with the conservatives in the legislature and executive branch to secure our elections once and for all.

I have a conservative team behind me supporting my [Roadmap to Restore Election Integrity](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4e014e5f06&e=a7ab36849c). Join us in the fight for Arizona. Nothing can get done if our democracy is compromised.
---
| [Help Send A Fighter You Can Trust to the Office of Secretary of State](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=098a935941&e=a7ab36849c "Help Send A Fighter You Can Trust to the Office of Secretary of State")
---
| Thank you once again for your continued support,

Michelle Lujan Grisham

Every election is so important. But more is on the line this year than ever before!!! Abortion rights, gun safety, the climate, our very democracy itself. It’s a LOT. I ran for Congress in 2014 against Tom Reed to fight for Upstate New Yorkers and build a stronger middle class by bringing jobs and economic development back to our community. Now, I’m reaching out on behalf of my friend Josh Riley. He is a true advocate for our community - and the person most likely to win in November and fight for our values and concerns in Congress. Look, running for Congress is not easy. Trust me, I know. ...especially when you’re up against special interest groups and corporate PACs like Josh is in his race. I know these fundraising emails aren’t fun, but with such incredibly high stakes, our grassroots supporters - like you - are absolutely critical. Peter, when so very much is on the line in this election, do you want to wonder, the day after, whether you could have done more to help Josh win?? Do you want to wonder, if only...? Our kids and grandkids need us to hold our Democratic House Majority - to codify Roe into law, pass real gun safety laws, invest in a green future, and protect the vote. | | | Hey there,

This weekend I had the chance to attend the WisDems 2022 Convention. It was great getting to see so many Democrats come together more united than ever. When I took the stage, I reminded my fellow Democrats we need to have an inclusive, positive, forward-looking message to bring more folks to the table.

I’m running for Congress in Wisconsin’s 5th District, because we have to compete everywhere and talk to everyone.

**The reality is that I’m running against a do-nothing Congressman in Scott Fitzgerald, who works to divide us at every turn and take away your voice. **

We cannot afford to stand around while he continues to work against the interests of the people of Wisconsin on everything from working to overturn a presidential election to voting against veterans and the middle class. I’m grateful for all the enthusiasm and support for my campaign.
****
One last thing, we have now extended our deadline for our t-shirts! Please put in your orders by July 8th. All our products are union-made in the USA. Show your support for the campaign with some MVS merch.

Despite what national Republicans seem to believe, Vermont is not for sale.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=588%2E61531%2ES92e9q)
Hello,
Our second end-of-quarter deadline of the year is in just a few days, and we’re doing all we can to meet our fundraising goals before the clock strikes midnight on Thursday. This is our first FEC filing deadline since the courts overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , which means we have a lot of work to do to show we’re ready for this moment. [**Can you pitch in $5 to this Senate campaign right away?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3036?t=3&akid=588%2E61531%2ES92e9q)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

Despite what national Republicans seem to believe, Vermont is not for sale. But that’s not going to stop them from trying to buy this seat by pouring as much money as they possibly can into our state in the coming days, weeks, and months.
Early voting in Vermont has already started for our primary, and there’s a lot of work we have to do to communicate to voters across the state. And with these fundraising numbers going public, it’s essential our opponents see the full strength of this grassroots movement. They’re looking for us to fall back or get complacent, and I know firsthand that’s not the makeup of this team. Let’s make it clear that we’re in this race to win it no matter what challenges they throw our way.
We’re just days away from one of our biggest fundraising deadlines of the year, and we need All Hands on Deck to meet this moment. [**Please consider a $5 donation to our campaign before our numbers go public. This is the most important FEC deadline we’ve faced yet, and we can’t fall short.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3036?t=7&akid=588%2E61531%2ES92e9q)
Thanks for all you do,
Peter

| | **This Week on the Campaign Trail** Hung and his team had a wonderful time walking in the Amissville Fire and Rescue Parade in Rappahannock County this week! While conversations about the state of this country are anything but uplifting, voters shared a spirit of hope and coming victory unlike any other. CAPT Cao was honored by the outpouring of support he received.
---

Loudoun County sure knows how to have a good time! Thank you to everyone that came to the GOP Jamboree and showed their support for the coming Red Wave in Virginia! We still need volunteers to help carry Hung across the finish line in November! We need volunteers to door knock or phone call voters in this district. Derek,

**The number they came up with is $730,000 in grassroots donations.**
Look, I don’t mean to sound cheeky. The stakes are too high for that. But let me tell you what happens if we don’t hit that goal, Derek.
When we report our fundraising numbers after the end of the quarter, Dr. Oz and + Republicans will see that our campaign isn’t keeping up. They’ll think we’re losing momentum. And they’ll believe they have a good chance of winning this seat – meaning they’ll start pouring even more millions into this race.
**We can’t let that happen.**
We're just days away from our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, but we’re still about $20,000 away from reaching our goal. 😐

clean_body: Democrats know they must re-elect our opponent, the nation’s most vulnerable Democrat, to keep complete control of the federal government. | Peter, Our campaign is THE top target of national Democrats. They're nervous because they must re-elect my opponent - who calls himself the most vulnerable incumbent Senate Democrat - in order to keep complete control of the federal government. And they will be watching Team Herschel's fundraising numbers closely. On Thursday, we will close the books for the second quarter of 2022. A few days later, our treasurer will report our fundraising totals to the Federal Election Commission (FEC). The Democrats and their powerful special interests will scour our report page-by-page, looking for any signs of weakness they can find. Peter, our goal is to show a massive groundswell of grassroots support from every county in the Peach State and every state in the nation. Our Democrat opponent has shattered early fundraising records and now has more than $23 million in his re-election war chest. Most of that money comes from blue states around the country, from the same folks who think our country is made stronger by pitting us against each other. Georgia's Senate race will almost certainly decide who controls the Senate majority and the direction of our nation. At stake are issues that affect every single one of us: who controls our schools, how much we pay to fill up our gas tank, the rising cost of groceries, and the ability for small businesses to find the workers they need to keep their doors open. Nothing I've accomplished in life has been easy and winning this U.S. Senate seat might be my toughest challenge yet. But we're up to the challenge because we have great friends and supporters like you standing with us every step of the way. Thanks for believing in me and standing by my side. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

After last week’s Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade,
Georgia’s current, extremist governor immediately filed notice to allow
his dangerous abortion ban — which outlaws abortion before many women even
know they are pregnant — to take effect.

You might be asking where we go from here: we can — and must — fight back.
And as of Friday, the fight for reproductive rights must be waged in the
states.

As governor, I will work every day to ensure access to affordable and safe
health care for all, including access to abortion. But first we have to
win in November.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220627_B2_Roe_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=777%2E1862389%2ERGIgKp ]If you’re able, can you make your
first investment in my
campaign now? Any amount helps ensure we can hold Brian Kemp accountable
for his dangerous anti-abortion agenda on Election Day.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220627_B2_Roe_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=777%2E1862389%2ERGIgKp ]DONATE

The governor of Georgia has made clear he does not care about women or
their healthcare. Our state is at or near the bottom on every health care
measure — from doctor and nursing shortages, to maternal and infant
mortality rates to shuttering three hospitals during the pandemic.

And if Kemp is allowed to have his way, things are only going to get
worse: Kemp’s six week ban won't put an end to abortions. It will only put
an end to safe abortions.

Millions of Georgians — especially low income, Black, brown and rural
women and LGBTQ+ people — are counting on us to hold him accountable for
his extremism,
Derek. But I cannot do it
alone. Are you with me?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1481?refcode=sa_em_220627_B2_Roe_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=777%2E1862389%2ERGIgKp ]These fights will not be easy, but they are ones we can win. Make your
first donation to my
campaign now to support our fight for reproductive rights in Georgia.

Together, we will make Georgia safe for women.

Stacey

Blocks Audit to Disclose Where Money is Going](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59250&L=27585&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYmlsbGlvbnMta2VlcC1mbG93aW5nLXRvLWFmZ2hhbmlzdGFuLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRpcHNoZWV0JnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=)** The U.S. has dropped a ghastly $146 billion on Afghanistan reconstruction in the last two decades and billions more continue to be spent, but the Biden administration is blocking federal auditors from conducting their congressionally mandated job of investigating where the money is going.
